title: TRUMP IS NOT MESSING AROUND
tags: the culture war with tim pool
description:
Trump’s FCC is moving to challenge ABC’s broadcast licenses following backlash over a controversial Jimmy Kimmel joke. The action targets local stations using public airwaves and marks a rare, aggressive regulatory step. The move escalates tensions between Trump, the media, and late-night television.
